# Core Summary
A tactile stop-motion clay animation set in a warm afternoon park, following a poignant micro-drama between three object-headed figures. The clip uses a multi-shot progression (6 shots) to depict intimacy, interruption, departure, and abandonment. Shot 1 establishes the cozy bench scene; Shot 2 captures the sudden reaction to a rumble; Shot 3 introduces the intruder on a motorcycle; Shot 4 shows the candle's visceral reaction; Shot 5 executes the departure; Shot 6 lingers on the lonely aftermath.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Miniature park setting with real grass blades and textured clay ground. A tiny wooden park bench sits center-frame, bathed in warm golden-hour sunlight casting long, soft shadows. Dust motes float in the air, visible in the light beams.
[shot2][00:03-00:05] Same park bench environment, slightly tighter framing. Lighting remains warm afternoon sun. Background slightly more out of focus to emphasize subject reaction.
[shot3][00:05-00:07] Close-up on a patch of park path, textured with gravel and clay. Warm sunlight hits the metallic surfaces of the incoming vehicle.
[shot4][00:07-00:09] Extreme close-up background blurred, focusing on the candle flame against the park greenery. Lighting highlights the translucency of the wax.
[shot5][00:09-00:12] Wide shot returning to the bench and path intersection. Sunlight flares slightly as the vehicle moves. Shadows shift dynamically with the motion.
[shot6][00:12-00:15] Close-up on the empty bench. Warm light remains, but the mood feels cooler due to absence. Ground below the bench is in focus for falling objects.

# Subjects Description
- `<ID_A>` (Matchbox Head): Male figure. Body made of beige modeling clay with visible fingerprints. Head is a miniature cardboard matchbox with a striker strip on the side. Wears a tiny knitted blue scarf and fabric trousers.
- `<ID_B>` (Candle Head): Female figure. Body made of smooth white clay. Head is a white wax candle with a real fabric wick and a flickering flame element. Wears a textured fabric skirt and clay boots.
- `<ID_C>` (Fire Extinguisher Head): Male figure. Body made of grey clay. Head is a miniature red fire extinguisher with a brass nozzle and a printed pressure gauge. Wears a black leather jacket and goggles.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Wide shot. `<ID_A>` and `<ID_B>` sit side-by-side on the tiny bench, `<ID_A>` on left, `<ID_B>` on right, facing slightly toward each other. Their clay hands gesture subtly in mid-conversation. The flame on `<ID_B>`'s head flickers gently. Real fabric clothes rustle slightly. Warm light glows on their surfaces.
[shot2][00:03-00:05] Medium shot. A low bass rumble sound vibrates the scene. Both `<ID_A>` and `<ID_B>` snap their heads to the right in unison. Their clay necks compress slightly with the sudden turn. The flame on `<ID_B>` leans from the motion.
[shot3][00:05-00:07] Close-up. `<ID_C>` rolls into frame from the right on a tiny metal motorcycle, tires kicking up microscopic dust. `<ID_C>` stops abruptly, body leaning forward, one clay hand loose on the handlebar. The pressure gauge on the head reads red. Engine idles with a heavy mechanical hum.
[shot4][00:07-00:09] Extreme close-up on `<ID_B>`. The flame on the candle head instantly doubles in size, glowing brighter. A thick drop of white wax forms at the base of the flame and drips straight down the face, solidifying as it cools.
[shot5][00:09-00:12] Wide shot. `<ID_B>` stands up smoothly, clay legs straightening, and smooths the fabric skirt. `<ID_B>` walks to the motorcycle and sits on the back behind `<ID_C>`. `<ID_C>` does not turn. The motorcycle accelerates and exits frame to the left, leaving `<ID_A>` alone on the bench.
[shot6][00:12-00:15] Close-up on `<ID_A>`. Sitting alone, the matchbox drawer on the face slides open slowly. Small wooden matches tumble out one by one, clattering onto the grass below. `<ID_A>` remains still, head slightly bowed.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Stop-motion clay animation aesthetic with high tactile fidelity. Visible fingerprints on clay surfaces, real fabric textures, and miniature props. Color palette is warm amber, green, and red accents. Lighting is directional golden-hour sun creating high contrast and rim lighting on the clay. Depth of field is shallow to mimic macro photography. Image quality is sharp but retains the slight jitter and charm of handcrafted animation.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Begins cozy and intimate, shifts to tense and mechanical, ends on a note of quiet melancholy and abandonment. The tactile nature of the materials enhances the emotional weight of the inanimate objects.
